User seeks ideas for organizing an art box and maximizing space (S1.U1). They are planning a cozy, welcoming art-themed party with stations for painting, collage, drawing, printmaking, mixed media, digital art, assemblage, art journaling, and a photo area with props/backdrops; they plan to display their artwork (S1.U2, S1.U3, S1.U5, S1.U6). An inspiration corner will feature The Artisan Post and Creative Corner (S1.U4).

User has Jack Harris’s digital print “Moonlit Ocean” and Emma Taylor’s painting “Ethereal Dreams.” After rearranging, “Moonlit Ocean” is on the bedroom wall and “Ethereal Dreams” is above the bed, adding a nice touch (S2.U1, S2.U4; superseded: “Ethereal Dreams” above the living-room sofa, S1.U3).

User’s next project combines abstract art, the human figure, surrealism, and lowbrow art: a figure floating/drifting in a misty, dreamlike environment inspired by “Moonlit Ocean” (S2.U2–S2.U4). They want soft pastel colors, calmness, serenity, depth, atmosphere, and movement (S2.U5, S2.U6). Planned techniques include glazing, soft brushstrokes, transparent washes, layering/blending, flowing or directional marks, blurred edges, gradated color, suggestive gestures, and swir
